description_zh: 调用ListIpSets接口查询指定全球加速实例的加速地域列表
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-ip-sets --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1yeeq8yfoyszmqy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpSets

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the GA instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

AccelerateRegionId.description_en: The ID of the acceleration region

Bandwidth.description_en: The bandwidth that is allocated to the acceleration region. Unit: Mbit/s
Bandwidth.description_zh: 加速地域分配的带宽，单位：Mbps

IpSetId.description_en: The ID of the acceleration region

IpVersion.description_en:
The IP version. Valid values:

IPv4
IPv6
DUAL_STACK
IpVersion.description_zh:
IP地址协议版本。取值：

IPv4

IPv6

DUAL_STACK

IspType.description_en:
The line type of the elastic IP address (EIP) in the acceleration region. Valid values:

BGP: BGP (Multi-ISP) lines. This is the default value.
BGP_PRO: BGP (Multi-ISP) Pro lines
IspType.description_zh:
加速地域公网线路类型。取值：
BGP（默认值）：BGP（多线）线路。
BGP_PRO：BGP（多线）_精品线路

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the instance.

This parameter takes effect only if ServiceManaged is set to true
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。

仅当ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance is managed. Valid values:

true
false
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The actions that users can perform on the managed instance.

This parameter takes effect only if ServiceManaged is set to true.
Users can perform only specific actions on a managed instance
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅当ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the action on the managed instance. Valid values:

Create
Update
Delete
Associate
UserUnmanaged
CreateChild
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:

Listener: listener.
IpSet: acceleration region.
EndpointGroup: endpoint group.
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule.
Endpoint: endpoint.
EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping of an endpoint group associated with a custom routing listener.
EndpointPolicy: traffic policy of an endpoint associated with a custom routing listener.

This parameter takes effect only if Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅当Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the specified actions are managed.

true: The specified actions are managed, and users cannot perform the actions on the managed instance.****
false: The specified actions are not managed, and users can perform the actions on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The status of the acceleration region. Valid values:

init: The acceleration region is being initialized.
active: The acceleration region is in the running state.
updating: The acceleration region is being configured.
deleting: The acceleration region is being deleted
State.description_zh:
加速地域状态。取值：

init：初始化。

active：运行中。

updating：配置中。

deleting：删除中

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
